profile.name: Chetna Verma
profile.title: B.A. LL.B Scholar & Legal Intern
profile.bio: Diligent and research-driven law student currently pursuing 1st Year of B.A. LL.B at Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC University), Mohali. Completed Senior Secondary from Mount Litera Zee School (60%) and High School from Kendriya Vidyalaya (KV) Kathua (57%). Passionate about Constitutional Law, Criminal & Civil Law, Legal Research, and Courtroom Advocacy. Actively seeking foundational legal internships under Advocates, Chambers, or Law Firms.
profile.seekingBannerText: Actively Seeking Legal Internship · Chamber / Firm Trainee
profile.aboutHeadline: Dedicated to Constitutional Principles, Rigorous Research & Advocacy

experience.company: Legal Aid Clinic & Pro Bono Cell, CGC University Mohali
experience.description: Participating actively in university legal literacy drives, assisting with basic legal documentation, and conducting case-law research under faculty guidance.
responsibilities: Conduct foundational legal research on consumer protection, fundamental rights, and civil remedies using SCC Online and Indian Kanoon.
Assist senior law scholars and faculty in cataloging citizen legal queries and preparing plain-language legal awareness briefs for community outreach.
Attend interactive legal workshops and mock trial advocacy sessions organized by the faculty and visiting High Court advocates.
Draft preliminary representations and summary notes on statutory rights for rural legal literacy camps in Mohali.

experience.description: Underwent court observation training, familiarizing with daily court procedures, case filing registries, and courtroom proceedings.
responsibilities: Observed daily proceedings in civil and criminal courts, taking structured notes on examinations and preliminary arguments.
Familiarized with courtroom filing registries, including vakalatnama submission, caveat petitions, and application tracking.
Prepared case briefs summarizing factual matrices and legal questions in ongoing civil suits.
Maintained chamber case diary and assisted in organizing precedent files for upcoming hearings.

skills.name: Constitutional Law of India (Fundamental Rights & Writs)
Law of Contracts & Specific Relief Act
Law of Torts & Consumer Protection Act 2019
Case Briefs & Synopsis of Dates and Events
Legal Documentation (MS Word, Excel & PDF Tools)

projects.name: Intra-University Moot Court Competition — Constitutional Law Memorial
projects.shortDescription: Drafted comprehensive petitioner memorial on Fundamental Rights & Digital Surveillance under Article 21.
projects.detailedDescription: Participated in the university moot court simulation examining constitutional validity of digital surveillance under Article 21. Researched authoritative Supreme Court precedents including K.S. Puttaswamy and drafted the statement of jurisdiction, issues, and arguments advanced.
architectureHighlights: Authored a structured 30-page petitioner memorial following official moot court rules
Researched 45+ constitutional judgments and judicial doctrines
Presented oral submissions in preliminary and quarter-final rounds

projects.name: Analytical Paper: Key Shifts from IPC to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS)
projects.shortDescription: Comparative study examining reforms, community service clauses, and electronic evidence under new criminal laws.
projects.detailedDescription: Compiled an in-depth research paper outlining key procedural and substantive changes brought by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, presented at the CGC Law Students Symposium.
architectureHighlights: Comparative mapping of pivotal sections between IPC and BNS
Analyzed newly introduced provisions for community service and organized crimes
Presented before faculty panel and awarded Commendation Certificate

projects.name: Rural Legal Literacy & Citizen Rights Drive (Mohali)
projects.shortDescription: Community legal aid initiative raising awareness on consumer protection and free legal aid under Article 39A.
projects.detailedDescription: Active student volunteer in the CGC University Legal Aid Clinic. Coordinated community workshops informing local residents about grievance redressal mechanisms, consumer dispute filing, and DLSA legal aid entitlements.
architectureHighlights: Assisted in coordinating legal awareness sessions for 80+ local citizens
Helped draft simplified bilingual pamphlets explaining legal remedies
Recognized by Faculty Convenor for dedicated volunteer participation
